split_policy: 60 source-labeled tasks; one task per unique family; 15 per platform; 30 answerable and 30 abstain; disjoint from checked development datasets
platform_ambiguity: Platform values follow corpus page directories. Common tasks are labeled against common-page examples; Linux, macOS, and Windows tasks use their platform page with common fallback.

provenance.authoring_method: 100 prompt-only tasks drafted from the pinned corpus inventory, with 20 supplemental likely-unsupported requests; no retrieval or candidate output was inspected
provenance.labeling_method: Separate label audit against the pinned parser-v4 matching database; exact example IDs checked for task-platform eligibility; unsupported tasks have empty acceptable IDs
